How to Write a Graphic Designer Resume

A graphic designer resume must work with a portfolio. Use the resume to explain your design role, system thinking, production scope, and collaboration; let the portfolio show the finished craft.

Example

Graphic Designer resume summary

Use this as a pattern for level, scope, specialty, and evidence. Do not copy facts that are not yours.

Graphic designer with 6 years of experience building campaign and brand systems across digital and print. Created reusable components that cut production time by 30% and supported launches in nine markets.
Recommended order

How to structure the resume

  1. Contact details and target title. Use the normal title from the job posting and provide working contact links.
  2. Focused summary. Establish your level, setting, specialty, and one representative outcome.
  3. Recent relevant experience. Use reverse chronological order and give the most space to work that resembles the target role.
  4. Role-specific skills. Keep a scannable list, then prove the important skills in bullets.
  5. Education and credentials. Place a direct portfolio link with the contact details. A design degree can help early on, but recent, well-explained work and strong fundamentals should dominate the page.
Use only what you can support

Skills to include

Match the employer's terminology when it accurately describes your experience.

  • Visual design
  • Brand systems
  • Typography
  • Art direction
  • Adobe Creative Suite
  • Figma
  • Production design
  • Creative collaboration
Evidence ideas

Useful metrics for a graphic designer resume

Numbers should clarify scope or change. They do not need to be revenue figures.

Efficiency

Production time or revision rounds

Scale

Markets, assets, channels, or launches

Performance

Conversion, engagement, or adoption when attributable

Writing patterns

Graphic Designer resume bullet examples

Adapt the action, context, and result to your own verified work.

  • Created a modular campaign system used across nine markets.
  • Cut production time by 30% by building reusable design components.
  • Partnered with marketing to refresh a product launch across web and print.
  • Directed vendor production for 120 assets while maintaining brand consistency.
Look for

Strong signals

  • Portfolio quality
  • Design systems
  • Production fluency
  • Creative collaboration
Avoid

Common mistakes

  • A decorative resume that is hard to scan
  • Portfolio links without project context
  • Listing software instead of design decisions
  • Claiming campaign performance you cannot attribute

Questions, answered

Resume FAQ

What should a graphic designer resume include?

Lead with portfolio quality, show relevant visual design experience in context, and use achievement bullets that explain scope and outcome.

What skills belong on a graphic designer resume?

Prioritize skills from the target job that you can prove in experience, projects, education, or credentials. Useful examples include visual design, brand systems, typography, art direction.

Can I use the example numbers and bullet points?

No. The examples demonstrate structure and specificity. Replace every action, number, tool, and result with evidence that is true for your own work.

Which resume format should I use?

Reverse chronological format works for most candidates. Use a combination format when projects or transferable skills need more emphasis, but keep dates and work history clear.
